name: Kamisama choose! Sensei Onna no Ko Niatteru Yo!
original_name: 神様ちゅ～ず！ センセー女の子似合ってるよっ！
source:
"I'm an angel. A real one."

The pretty, pale-skinned crossdresser, "Shirahato Inori," said that.
Floating next to him was a plushie-like creature he called "God."
Inori made money as an "angel" by granting wishes with God's power.
But to grant those wishes, he had to have sex with men and offer up the semen they pumped out inside him to God.
His homeroom teacher, Okihi Kanae, tried to stop Inori's "angel work," but Inori lost it and turned Kanae into a schoolgirl.

"Ahaha! This is awesome!"
"If you’re so worried about me, why not do my job yourself like that?!"

But Kanae didn’t back down.

"If I do that... will you come back to school?"

And so the teacher-turned-schoolgirl and the angel-crossdresser ended up living out their school days together—as classmates.

[Translated from [url=https://kumanomi-soft.amusecraft.com/kamichu/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
“我是一个天使。一个真正的天使。”

皮肤白皙、漂亮的异装者“白海祈”这么说道。
在他旁边漂浮着一个毛绒般的生物，他称之为“上帝”。
祈以“天使”的身份，通过神的力量实现愿望来赚钱。
但为了实现这些愿望，他必须与男人发生性关系，并将他们在他体内泵出的精液献给上帝。
他的班主任冲日佳苗试图阻止祈的“天使工作”，但祈却失败了，并把鼎变成了一名女学生。

“啊哈哈！这太棒了！”
“如果你这么担心我，为什么不自己做我的工作呢？！”

但鼎并没有退缩。

“如果我这么做的话……你会回学校吗？”

就这样，这位教师出身的女学生和这位变装天使最终以同学的身份一起度过了学生时代。

[翻译自[url=https://kumanomi-soft.amusecraft.com/kamichu/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
